item.title: Horizontal ridge augmentation: tunneling holds its own against the flap
item.description: In brief: In 43 patients, tunneling and conventional flap produced comparable width gain at 6 months (no significant difference, p > 0.05).
item.category: Clinical implant dentistry and related research

item.title: Peri-implant bone loss: abutment height matters in screw-retained cases
item.description: In brief: Reclassifying studies by retention type resolves much of the inconsistency on abutment height and marginal bone loss.

item.title: Save the tooth or replace it? In the Swedish cohort, it depends on the site
item.description: In brief: Swedish national cohort, over 16,000 propensity-matched patients, followed up to 9 years

item.title: ARP vs GBR: no single technique wins across all defects
item.description: In brief: Systematic review of 14 RCTs on alveolar ridge preservation (ARP) and guided bone regeneration (GBR)

item.title: Peri-implantitis surgery: submerged or not matters less than the patient in front of you
item.description: In brief: 2-year retrospective study, 33 patients and 53 implants treated with reconstructive surgery for peri-implantitis
item.category: Clinical implant dentistry and related research

item.title: In Switzerland, edentulism among seniors fell from 44% to 4% in 40 years
item.description: In brief: Meta-analysis of over 50 years of Swiss data on oral health in adults 65+

item.description: In brief: In mice, OTUD1 stabilizes BMP2 mRNA and pushes mesenchymal stem cells toward bone formation

item.title: Gum bacteria in the bloodstream: a fresh signal for coronary risk
item.description: In brief: Oral P. gingivalis positivity was independently associated with higher CHD prevalence in this angiography cohort (PR 1.24).

item.title: HbA1c outpredicts every other glycemic marker for periodontitis severity
item.description: In brief: FBG, PPBS, and HbA1c all worsened stepwise with periodontitis severity in 396 patients (p<0.001).

item.title: Systemic conditions didn't predict implant loss over 11 years
item.description: In brief: Across 1,872 implants (602 patients), success was statistically identical between systemically healthy (96.76%) and compromised (97.60%)…

item.title: Nonsurgical EMD matched surgery for intrabony defects in this RCT

item.title: Severe Periodontitis Flags Hidden Coronary Risk
item.description: In brief: Severe periodontitis (6% of 29,056 adults) was associated with higher coronary calcium levels (an indication of atherosclerosis).

item.title: Tooth Loss Tracks With Blood Markers of Neurodegeneration
item.description: In brief: In 4,238 US adults 50+, edentulism predicted a 49% higher risk of cognitive impairment and 28% higher risk of dementia over 10 years

item.title: Membrane Stiffness May Shape Early GBR Healing, Not the Outcome
item.description: In brief: Preclinical (beagle) model compared two collagen membranes with different thickness/stiffness in lateral bone augmentation

item.title: Donor-Derived Dentin Matches Xenograft in Sinus Lift
item.description: In brief: Randomized split-mouth trial (n=9, bilateral sinus augmentation) comparing allogenic demineralized dentin matrix (ADDM) vs xenograft
item.category: Journal of Advanced Periodontology & Implant Dentistry

item.title: Hyaluronic Acid Boosts Early Stability in Immediate Implants
item.description: In brief: RCT, 16 immediate implants: bovine bone + hyaluronic acid vs unfilled fresh socket (control)

item.title: Periodontitis and diabetes: the risk really does run both ways
item.description: In brief: Periodontitis at baseline predicted 18-25% more newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes over follow-up.

item.title: A new cellular hub behind bone loss in periodontitis
item.description: In brief: Ectopic immune structures (tertiary lymphoid structures) form in gingiva as inflammation worsens and track with worse surgical outcomes.

item.title: Leftover pockets after perio therapy don't stay quiet at implants
item.description: In brief: Four cohort studies (1-23 year follow-up) consistently linked residual periodontal pockets after therapy to higher peri-implantitis rates.
item.category: Clinical Implant Dentistry and Related Research

item.title: Zirconia implants: low peri-implantitis rates, at least short-term
item.description: In brief: Pooled peri-implantitis prevalence around zirconia implants was 2% up to 5 years, rising to 8% beyond 5 years (wide CI).
item.category: Clinical Implant Dentistry and Related Research

item.title: Even routine antibiotic prophylaxis leaves a mark on the microbiome
item.description: In brief: A single prophylactic antibiotic course before dental surgery significantly disrupted oral and gut microbial diversity, peaking at days 3-10.
item.category: Journal of the American Dental Association

item.title: What AI Can (and Can't Yet) See on a Peri-Implantitis X-Ray

item.description: In brief: In this pilot RCT (n=21, 7/group), insulin, HA, and collagen sponge alone all improved CAL and PPD equally at 6 months in intrabony defects…

item.title: Thin Gingival Phenotype Emerges as the Strongest Peri-Implant Risk Signal in a 968-Implant Cohort
item.description: In brief: In 968 implants (199 patients), 26.4% showed some degree of peri-implant disease (17.9% mucositis, 8.5% peri-implantitis).

item.title: Wide-diameter implants: failure risk shifts with time after placement
item.description: In brief: 97.5% overall survival across more than 12,000 implants ≥5.0 mm followed for up to 10 years.
item.category: Clinical implant dentistry and related research

item.title: Sleep apnea and periodontitis: a plausible link resting on weak evidence
item.description: In brief: 70% of included studies (14/20) report a significant association between OSA and periodontitis.

item.title: It's not the penicillin allergy — it's the alternative antibiotic chosen
item.description: In brief: Across 374 implants, early failure was 6.1% and surgical complications 8.0%.
item.category: Clinical implant dentistry and related research

item.title: Fewer teeth, same accuracy: a faster way to score plaque
item.description: In brief: An optimized 12-surface subset reproduces full-mouth plaque scores almost perfectly (ICC 0.962).

item.title: Triangular-neck implants perform well — but nobody has compared them head-to-head
item.description: In brief: Pooled analysis of 5 studies shows mean 1-year marginal bone loss of just 0.35 mm. Pooled implant survival rate is 97.8%.

item.category: Clinical implant dentistry and related research

item.title: L-PRF in intrabony defects: a real 1.1 mm gain, but evidence stays weak
item.description: In brief: 23 RCTs pooled: L-PRF+OFD vs OFD alone at 9 months 1.11 mm PPD reduction and 1.13 mm CAL gain, statistically significant

item.title: Short implants vs vertical GBR: the 8-year model favors the simpler choice
item.description: In brief: 8-year microsimulation model: short implants (6-8.5mm) without GBR vs regular (>10mm) with vertical GBR

item.title: Immediate implants in diabetics survive — but bone pays the price of glycemic control
item.description: In brief: Meta-analysis of 10 studies (1,350 patients, 1,623 implants): implant survival does NOT differ between diabetics and healthy patients,…

item.title: Antibiotics add half a millimetre in peri-implantitis — local beats systemic
item.description: In brief: Across 22 RCTs, adjunctive antibiotics improved PPD by ~0.69 mm and CAL by ~0.55 mm over debridement alone — statistically significant,…

item.title: Xenogeneic blocks match autogenous bone at 4 years — except in the esthetic zone
item.description: In brief: At 4 years, collagenated xenogeneic and autogenous bone blocks gave comparable implant survival and success after lateral ridge augmentation.

item.title: Fascia lata allograft thickens peri-implant mucosa without a palatal harvest
item.description: In brief: In a 16-patient pilot RCT, fascia lata allograft and connective tissue graft both significantly increased peri-implant mucosal thickness and…

item.description: In brief: GLP-1 receptor agonists may affect periodontal tissues both indirectly (glycemic control, weight, inflammation) and directly (GLP-1R / DPP-4…

item.title: Past 10 cigarettes a day, GBR implants lose twice the bone
item.description: In brief: In this 5-year cohort, smokers of >10 cigarettes/day lost about twice the marginal bone (2.67 mm) of non- and light smokers (1.34-1.40 mm).

item.title: PEEK or titanium mesh for the ridge? They tie once you control the graft
item.description: In brief: RCT in 14 patients (28 sites): no significant difference in horizontal bone gain between prebent titanium mesh (3.02 mm) and customized PEEK…

item.title: Thin-phenotype lower recessions: the tunnel beats the envelope flap
item.description: In brief: RCT in 59 patients (103 lower-incisor sites, thin phenotype): at 6 months the tunnel + CTG gave 79% mean root coverage vs 58% for the envelope…

item.title: Putting a number on periodontitis as cardiovascular risk: a proposed score
item.description: In brief: A narrative review proposing the Endothelial Risk Score (ERS): it combines Periodontal Inflamed Surface Area (PISA) with age, sex, systolic BP,…

item.title: Oral disease leads NCD prevalence — and periodontal disability rises with wealth
item.description: In brief: In 2023, oral disorders in Latin America and the Caribbean caused 308 million prevalent cases and 2.41 million years lived with disability —…

item.title: GBR membranes: a 26% complication rate forces a rethink beyond passive occlusion
item.description: In brief: A meta-analysis of 100 studies puts GBR complication rates near 26%, exposing the structural limits of conventional collagen and PTFE membranes.

item.title: Augmented vs native posterior mandible: which bone hosts healthier implants at 15 years?
item.description: In brief: Implant survival was nearly identical at 15 years: 94.7% in native bone, 95.3% in augmented bone.
item.category: International Journal of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery

item.title: Peri-implantitis debridement: less than 1 mm cleaned in this SEM cohort
item.description: In brief: SEM analysis of 49 explanted implants found a mean contaminant-free zone of just 0.66 mm (range 0–3.0 mm).
